name: What does commercial fire damage restoration involve?

mainEntity.name: What does commercial fire damage restoration involve?

acceptedAnswer.text: Commercial fire damage restoration is a comprehensive process to repair and restore a business property after a fire. It typically includes emergency services like board-up and water extraction, followed by soot and smoke removal, structural cleaning, deodorization, and content restoration. The goal is to return the property to its pre-fire condition, addressing structural integrity, air quality, and aesthetic damage to minimize business interruption.
acceptedAnswer.description: It involves emergency services, soot and smoke removal, cleaning, deodorization, and structural repairs to restore a commercial property after a fire.
